name: chat-bubble
description: A conversational chat UI kit — message bubbles (bot/user), a typing indicator, clickable suggestion chips, and a combined text-input + send control. Built for AI/agent chat surfaces.

figmaReference.note: No published Figma component set located for this component. Token intent is captured in a comment block at the top of chat-bubble.tsx. Figma parity NOT verified — see meta.knownIssues.

intent.bot: Assistant/agent message — left-aligned, surface/default fill with border, avatar shown, pointed top-left corner.
intent.user: Person's message — right-aligned, brand/primary fill, no avatar, pointed top-right corner.

spacing.note: Spacing uses Tailwind utilities (gap-2, gap-1, px-3, py-2) per the Storybook Build Process spacing rule (fixed 2026-07-02).

accessibility.role: none on bubbles (plain text); interactive controls are native button/input elements
accessibility.screenReader: ChatInput field has aria-label='Chat input'; send button has aria-label='Send message'. ChatLog wraps the message list with role='log' aria-live='polite' so new messages are announced to screen readers automatically.
accessibility.keyboard: ChatInput: Enter sends (Shift+Enter reserved for newline). Send button disabled when input is empty.
accessibility.reducedMotion: TypingIndicator uses animate-bounce — NOT gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. Flag for reduced-motion review.

constraints: Custom component — no shadcn base and (currently) no Figma component set.
Bot messages show an Avatar (size=sm); user messages must not.
Use for conversational/agent surfaces only — not for static comment threads (use a list + Item instead).
Message list should be wrapped in an aria-live region by the consumer for screen-reader announcements.

useCases: An AI assistant panel where bot and user messages alternate
A prompt playground showing conversation history with a send input
Showing a 'thinking' state via TypingIndicator while a response streams
Offering quick follow-up questions under a bot reply via SuggestionChip

bot.whenToUse: Any message authored by the assistant/agent.

user.whenToUse: Any message authored by the person.

comparedTo.situation: Rendering a non-conversational list of records with metadata
comparedTo.notInstead: chat-bubble (chat-bubble implies a two-party conversation with directional alignment)

openQuestions: Is there an intended Figma component set for Chat, or is this deliberately code-only?
notes: 2026-07-02: Documented retroactively — component existed in Storybook (Chat/ChatBubble, 7 stories) with no meta.json, no tracker row, and no llms.txt entry. Added during a Storybook check.
Built outside the documented build pipeline; not yet spec-audited or Figma-parity checked.

knownIssues.issue: Figma parity unverified — no located Figma component set.
knownIssues.workaround: Confirm whether a Figma source exists; if code-only, mark codeOnly and drop the parity gate.

changelog.change: Initial meta.json created (retroactive documentation of an undocumented component).

Code spec-fixed: lucide-react CornerDownLeft → @untitledui/icons; CSS-var spacing → Tailwind utilities (gap-2/gap-1/px-3/py-2); TypingIndicator dots now motion-reduce:animate-none. Verified in Storybook (fresh restart, iframe 200, no compile errors).
Markdown spec written (Component Markdown (reference)/ChatBubble.md) — full anatomy, token bindings, accessibility, behavior, usage, and open questions.

Added ChatLog export — accessible message container (role='log' aria-live='polite'), resolving the live-region open question. FullConversation story now wraps messages in ChatLog. 'Chat' confirmed as an official category and added to the Storybook Build Process category→title map.

darkMode.notes: All fills use semantic mode-aware tokens, so light/dark should follow automatically. Not verified in dark mode.
darkMode.pairedSurfaceRisk: botBubble text color/background/default/foreground sits on color/surface/default fill — verify this pairing resolves correctly in dark mode.

notes: Five exports in one file: ChatBubble (message), ChatLog (accessible message container), TypingIndicator (thinking dots), SuggestionChip (follow-up button), ChatInput (input + send).
ChatLog sets role='log' aria-live='polite' aria-relevant='additions' — announces new messages to screen readers automatically.
ChatInput is controlled+uncontrolled (uses value/onChange when provided, internal state otherwise).
Depends on the Avatar component (size=sm) for bot messages.
